purpose: Independent near-miss controls for each rule with zero upstream negative fixtures in qualification-manifest.json; finite differential evidence, not exhaustive equivalence.

oracle.source: one fragment, raw content and path from each row, StartLine=1
oracle.exception: For rows with isolated=true, retain config.Default global filters and only polymarket-address with skipReport=false; default config never reports this orphan.

input_derivation: Take the named baseline from oracle.jsonl.gz, or orphan-isolated-oracle.jsonl for the unreachable orphan. Identify target rule in top-level or component findings. Replace every occurrence of its match.value by the named mutation, preserving remaining content and path.

mutations.baseline: Unchanged positive fixture; proves target remains reachable under this configuration.
mutations.delete-last: Remove the final character of the matched value.
mutations.low-entropy: Replace value by the same number of A characters.

limitations: Systematic mutations reuse known positive fixtures rather than sampling realistic benign repositories.
Each ID has finite negative evidence; input space and all filter branches are not exhausted.
Some mutations remain positive by design; expected output preserves these outcomes instead of relabeling them negative.
The orphan polymarket-address is only detectable in the explicitly isolated probe; full configuration reachability remains absent.
Other rules may still report a target-negative fragment; all findings and component groups are compared.
